verdict.rationale: The pack never documents load-based autoscaling. It mentions a global CDN, serverless functions and DDoS protection, which are adjacent features rather than a documented capability that scales capacity automatically under load. The community DDoS-billing threads describe cost overruns, not autoscaling behavior, so they cannot be credited for this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically
